_note: Brassmarch, level 15: clockwork that can only be blocked. See docs/zones.md.

brassmarch.name: Brassmarch
brassmarch.description: Endless still plains of brass, worked by machines whose makers are gone.

bm_landing.name: The Gate Cogs
bm_landing.description: Turning gears, and through them the fire of the Ember Courts.

bm_works.name: The Gearworks
bm_works.description: A workshop the size of a cathedral. One old man works in it.

bm_plain.name: The Brass Plain
bm_plain.description: Brass to the horizon, ticking in the still air.

bm_rail.name: The Rail Yard
bm_rail.description: Rails running off in every direction, and engines on them that move by themselves.

bm_seat.name: The Arbiter's Seat
bm_seat.description: A tall brass figure on a throne, frozen mid-gesture. A keyhole in its chest.

features.keyhole: A keyhole the size of a fist.

bm_engine_gate.name: The Engine Gate
bm_engine_gate.description: The gate of the Grand Engine, guarded by brass sentinels.

bm_engine.name: The Grand Engine
bm_engine.description: The heart of Brassmarch: an automaton a hundred feet tall, its eyes lighting up.

great_key.name: great key
great_key.description: A brass key as long as your arm.

odo.name: Odo
odo.label: Last Engineer
odo.description: an old man with goggles and a beard full of oil
odo.details: An old man with goggles and a beard full of oil.

topics.work: Ask me about the arbiter, or the scrap.

arbiter.text: The Arbiter judged every machine here, until it ran down. Wind it with this great key. Machines can only be blocked, by the way. Bring a shield.

scrap.text: Spider-engines. They eat everything. Five of them, scrapped.

lure.sense: {Where}, the tick and clank of a great machine.
lure.rumour: The old engineer in the Gearworks talks to anyone who'll listen.

arbiter.name: the Arbiter
arbiter.label: Automaton
arbiter.description: a tall brass figure on a throne
arbiter.details: A tall brass figure on a throne.

engine.text: THE GRAND ENGINE HAS GONE MAD. IT MUST BE STOPPED. YOU WILL STOP IT.

lure.rumour: They say the brass Arbiter still speaks, to those it chooses.

gearwright_gloves.name: Gearwright's Goggles

brassmarch-gate.depart: The gears turn, and the heat hits you.
brassmarch-gate.arrive: {actor} steps out of the turning gears.

key.goal: Take Odo's great key: DISCUSS KEY WITH ODO.

wind.goal: Wind the Arbiter, at its seat on the plain: GIVE KEY TO ARBITER.

effects.text: The Arbiter's eyes light. Its head turns, with a great grinding, to you.

back.goal: Tell Odo: DISCUSS ARBITER WITH ODO.
Tell Odo: DISCUSS SCRAP WITH ODO.
Tell the Arbiter: DISCUSS ENGINE WITH ARBITER.
